result: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence confirms a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate obtained from PQ148. The move is chargeable; charge level increases damage/hit count, and a successful first beam produces a follow-up Ki Wave. Current evidence also supports Kale (Super Saiyan 2) and Kefla (Super Saiyan) partner availability while preserving null race_restriction for CaC scope.
evidence_boundary: No unsupported reward probability, hidden prerequisite, frame data, or version-independent numerical mechanics were inferred.
